---
name: proposal-drafting
description: Use when a qualified opportunity needs a proposal — draft scope, pricing tiers, and the summary.
---
# Proposal Drafting
1. Pull the discovery notes, goals, and budget signals from CRM + call transcripts.
2. Draft scope tied to their stated goals; offer 3 pricing tiers (good/better/best).
3. Write the executive summary and expected outcomes. Draft for review (propose) — pricing always needs human sign-off.
